title: Hero's Tiered
description: Adds tiers/modifiers for tools/armors. Port for NeoForge from TieredZ's Globox
body:
![Hero's Tiered Text Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/735cd6f48133598c649bfaf747e24817ab0b894d.png)

Hero's Tiered is a port from TieredZ's Globox.

Any tools or armor you create, find, or trade will have special modifiers.

This mod was written from scratch, but it's essentially the same as TieredZ, only in NeoForge. I have the permission from Globox to do this.


<details>
<summary>Reforge gear</summary>
Items can be reforged to roll new tiers using the Reforge Screen, accessible via a tab in the Anvil interface.
  
![Reforge gear tab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2afa0e37578293ec90783081887da27b8aa5eee.png)

- Center Slot: The item to be reforged.

- Left Slot (Base Material): The repair material.

- Right Slot (Addition): Amethyst required to do the reforge.

### More details in [source code](https://github.com/Herobrot/tieredneo/blob/1.21/README.md#customization)

</details>
